For example: `Вернуть истину.` instead `Вернуть истина.`, yet both `истина` and `истину` should reference to the same variable or constant and so on. `не больше числа` instead of `не больше число`, and so on. Sometimes mapping is not correct: `System.out.println("fibonacci(" + index + ") = " + fibonacci(index));` was not mapped to `fibonacci "$index" echo "fibonacci($index) = $REPLY"` visually. We need to double check all the nuances, and and make sure we do them right. Another example here shows that Russian translation of comments is not done fully: For example `sequence` and `iteratively` was not translated to Russian. Some translations have clearly a bug `**` is supported in JavaScript and was not translated to Python: We need to double check we support exactly all operators in all languages, as these are the most basic syntax constructions. Translation of this fails: ``` @PostMapping public ResponseEntity createUser( @RequestBody @Valid CreateUserRequest request) { UserDto user = userService.createUser(request); return ResponseEntity .status(HttpStatus.CREATED) .body(user); } ``` We should have listed all similar projects to our project, so we can use all the best practices from them, and have automated grammar translations from their grammar format to our grammar format, which we can use to translate to our own code, so we can have combined and merged and modified if needed grammars for all languages, so we can programmatically convert their grammars to our grammar parser, and also have ability to get updates, and also use transformation before and after as needed, so we still have full control of resulting source code, and unified grammar and separate grammars, all work perfectly according to our needs. By default automatic detection should select the most popular language in this case English, which is able to parse the expression: So by choosing the most popular natural or programming language when auto detecting we are more likely to be correct. And here we have bug described as: `JS const array позволяет добавлять элементы а для Rust он должен быть mutable`, we need to double check we support all nuances of all languages perfectly. And all features of all languages should be supported in all of them similarly. We should deeply think about that here and support the best we can find about questions translation from natural language to programming languages. ``` int main(int argc, char** argv) { try{ int i=0; throw 8; } catch(int e) { return e; } return 0; } ``` Translation of this C++ to other languages failed, also it detects as C, and on change to C++ it fails completely it fills the input (source) with errors, yet we should just change the language of translation in case auto-detect failed and we just switching to C++ in UI.
